warnings: *** THIS SECTION RESOLVES THE OPEN QUESTION FLAGGED ON A-09, AND IT CONFIRMS THE READING TAKEN THERE. *** A-09's two stair views are PLANS and print only 0.225, which was recorded there as the going with an explicit note that no riser dimension exists on that sheet and none was invented. This section prints the riser directly: 0.189, repeated down the left-hand chain, alongside 0.275 + 0.225 repeated along the bottom. The arithmetic closes exactly - 18 risers x 0.189 = 3.402 m against the 3.40 m between the +0.60 and +4.00 floor levels - so 0.225 really was the going and 0.189 really is the riser. Nothing on A-09 needs correcting; it was correctly left blank rather than guessed.

THE STEPS ARE NUMBERED 1 TO 18 ON THE SECTION, which is the first place in the set the total is stated. The landing at +2.49 splits them 10 below (10 x 0.189 = 1.89, +0.60 + 1.89 = +2.49 exactly) and 8 above (8 x 0.189 = 1.512, +2.49 + 1.51 = +4.00). Both halves close to the centimetre, which is why the step count is recorded as fact rather than as a reading off circled digits.

THE BOTTOM CHAIN'S 3.00 IS THE ข-TO-ค GRID BAY, not the stair going total - the two bubbles under it are the grid lines. It matches the master's 3.00 m ค-to-ข spacing, so this sheet is another independent confirmation of the y grid.

THE STAIR IS TIMBER, NOT CONCRETE - ลูกนอน, แม่บันได, ราว, ลูกกรง and เสารับราว are all ไม้แดง, the landing joists and the supporting beam are ไม้เต็ง. That matters because S-02's upper-floor plan carries a concrete beam marked B1ชานพัก at the landing: the concrete beam supports a timber stair, which is consistent, not a conflict. Note S-04 details no B1ชานพัก section - flagged on the S-02 file as a real gap in the drawings.
This file is one of three views on หน้า11 per §3; the others are the two ราวบันได enlargements and the two หัวบันได enlargements.
